# OpenType Profile 1

Profile hash: `48eb6005e32aee2d87678c7e54559277013aad064b3266e6325f64c7211b2737`

What this system's font parser reads, and what it REFUSES. Anything outside this document is a
typed `Unsupported` refusal naming what was outside it - not undefined behaviour, not a silent
wrong result, and not a best effort. A font is untrusted content that arrives from a document, a
download or a package.

## Tables

A table at a major version this list does not carry is refused: a layout this parser has never
seen is one it would be guessing at. `any` means the table has no version field of its own.

| table | versions | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `head` | 1 | the design grid, the index-to-loc format and the font-wide bounding box |
| `hhea` | 1 | the horizontal metrics header, and how many are in `hmtx` |
| `hmtx` | any | horizontal advances and left side bearings |
| `maxp` | 0, 1 | the glyph count; version 0.5 for `CFF` outlines and 1.0 for `glyf` |
| `cmap` | 0 | character to glyph, in the subtable formats the profile admits |
| `name` | 0, 1 | the family, subfamily and instance names a catalogue declaration is checked against |
| `OS/2` | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 | the weight, width and slant class, and the typographic metrics line layout reads |
| `post` | 2, 3 | glyph names where version 2.0 carries them; 3.0 carries none and that is not an error |
| `loca` | any | the offset of each glyph in `glyf`, short or long per `head` |
| `glyf` | any | quadratic outlines, composite glyphs and their point-matching form |
| `CFF ` | 1 | Type 2 charstrings with local and global subroutines |
| `CFF2` | 2 | CFF2 charstrings with `blend` and variation-store selection |
| `vhea` | 1 | the vertical metrics header |
| `vmtx` | any | vertical advances and top side bearings |
| `VORG` | 1 | the vertical origin, where a font states it rather than deriving it |
| `GDEF` | 1 | glyph classes, mark attachment classes, mark glyph sets and the variation store |
| `GSUB` | 1 | substitution, including `FeatureVariations` |
| `GPOS` | 1 | positioning, including device and variation adjustments |
| `fvar` | 1 | the axes and the named instances |
| `gvar` | 1 | outline deltas for `glyf` fonts |
| `avar` | 1 | axis normalisation mapping |
| `HVAR` | 1 | horizontal advance variation - what makes a metric correct at a non-default coordinate |
| `VVAR` | 1 | the same for vertical advances |
| `MVAR` | 1 | the font-wide metrics line layout reads, varied |
| `COLR` | 0, 1 | layer lists (v0) and the paint graph (v1) |
| `CPAL` | 0, 1 | the palettes a colour glyph names |
| `sbix` | 1 | bitmap strikes |
| `CBDT` | 2, 3 | embedded colour bitmap data |
| `CBLC` | 2, 3 | the location table for `CBDT` |

## Excluded, by name

A reader cannot tell a deliberate omission from a forgotten one by looking at a list of what IS
supported, so the omissions are listed too.

| excluded | tables | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SVG glyph outlines | `SVG ` | SVG parsing is deferred by name elsewhere in this tree; admitting it here would make a font an entry point to an XML parser |
| the legacy kern table | `kern` | GPOS is the mechanism this profile positions with, and honouring both means deciding which wins in the fonts that carry two disagreeing answers |
| Apple Advanced Typography | `morx`, `mort`, `kerx`, `feat` | a second, differently shaped shaping engine, for fonts that also carry GSUB and GPOS - two engines means deciding which one a font meant |
| monochrome bitmap strikes as a glyph source | `EBDT`, `EBLC`, `EBSC` | the run contract requires a face that can be transformed and scaled, and a strike-only face cannot answer that; colour strikes are admitted because they are a colour glyph's own form rather than the face's outlines |
| avar version 2 | - | its axis-mapping model is a different one, and a profile that admitted it silently would change what a named instance means; avar version 1 IS supported, which is why this exclusion names no tag |
| hinting programs, and the instructions inside glyf | `fpgm`, `prep`, `cvt ` | a bytecode interpreter is a second execution engine reading untrusted input; this profile rasterises hinting-free, which is what its subpixel positioning is for |

## Lookup flags

| flag | name | effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0001` | `rightToLeft` | cursive attachment takes its direction from the run rather than the font |
| `0x0002` | `ignoreBaseGlyphs` | base glyphs are skipped when matching |
| `0x0004` | `ignoreLigatures` | ligature glyphs are skipped when matching |
| `0x0008` | `ignoreMarks` | mark glyphs are skipped when matching |
| `0x0010` | `useMarkFilteringSet` | only the marks in the named `GDEF` mark glyph set participate |
| `0xff00` | `markAttachmentType` | only marks of the named `GDEF` attachment class participate |

## Variation

Named as MECHANISMS rather than as tables: `fvar` and `gvar` make an outline vary and do nothing
for a metric, so a font instanced without `HVAR` has correct outlines at the wrong advances.

| mechanism | what it varies, and what is wrong without it |
| --- | --- |
| fvar axes | the axes themselves and their ranges; without it a font has no instances to select |
| fvar named instances | the named positions a catalogue declaration and a user both name |
| avar normalisation | the mapping from a user coordinate to a normalised one; without it an instance lands somewhere else on a font that maps its axes |
| gvar outline deltas | `glyf` outlines at a coordinate, including the inferred-point rule for unreferenced points |
| CFF2 blend | CFF2 outlines, varied in the charstring through `blend` and the region selected by `vsindex` |
| item variation store | the shared delta storage `HVAR`, `VVAR`, `MVAR`, `GDEF` and CFF2 all read through |
| delta-set index map | the indirection from a glyph or a value to its delta set |
| HVAR advances | horizontal advances at a coordinate - what makes a metric correct rather than merely present |
| VVAR advances | the same vertically, which the run contract's vertical directions need |
| MVAR font metrics | ascender, descender, line gap, x-height, cap height and the rest, at a coordinate |
| GDEF variation store | varying attachment points and caret positions |
| FeatureVariations | WHICH lookups apply at a coordinate; see the layout module |

## Colour: the `COLR` v1 paint graph

A variable counterpart at `format + 1` is admitted with its paint, where the format has one.

| 4 | `PaintLinearGradient` | yes | a two-point gradient with a rotation point |
| 6 | `PaintRadialGradient` | yes | a two-circle gradient |
| 8 | `PaintSweepGradient` | yes | an angular gradient |
| 10 | `PaintGlyph` | no | a glyph outline used as a clip for the paint below it |
| 11 | `PaintColrGlyph` | no | another colour glyph, by glyph id |
| 12 | `PaintTransform` | yes | an affine transform of the paint below |
| 14 | `PaintTranslate` | yes | a translation |

| 20 | `PaintScaleUniform` | yes | a uniform scale |
| 22 | `PaintScaleUniformAroundCenter` | yes | a uniform scale about a point |
| 24 | `PaintRotate` | yes | a rotation |
| 26 | `PaintRotateAroundCenter` | yes | a rotation about a point |

## Languages

A language is here because it CHANGES something, and what it changes is written down. An unknown
`LangSys` falls back to `dflt` rather than refusing - the one fallback in this profile, and what
the format itself does.

| tag | language | what selecting it changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dflt` | Default | the script's own features, with no language-specific substitution |
| `TRK ` | Turkish | dotless i and its casing pair, through `locl` |
| `AZE ` | Azerbaijani | the same dotless i behaviour as Turkish |
| `CRT ` | Crimean Tatar | the same dotless i behaviour |
| `DEU ` | German | the capital sharp s, and ligature suppression across compound boundaries |
| `NLD ` | Dutch | the IJ digraph as one letter for casing and for selection |
| `CAT ` | Catalan | the middle dot in `l·l`, which must not become a ligature |
| `ROM ` | Romanian | comma-below rather than cedilla on s and t |
| `MOL ` | Moldavian | the same comma-below forms |
| `SRB ` | Serbian | the italic Cyrillic forms of be, ghe, de, pe and te |
| `MKD ` | Macedonian | the italic Cyrillic forms of ghe and de |
| `ARA ` | Arabic | the default Arabic language forms |
| `FAR ` | Persian | Persian forms of yeh, kaf and the digits |
| `URD ` | Urdu | Urdu forms, including the heh and yeh variants |
| `SND ` | Sindhi | the Sindhi forms of the implosive letters, which Arabic and Urdu shape differently |
| `ZHS ` | Chinese, simplified | the regional glyph forms of shared ideographs |
| `ZHT ` | Chinese, traditional | the regional glyph forms of shared ideographs |
| `JAN ` | Japanese | the Japanese regional forms |
| `KOR ` | Korean | the Korean regional forms |
